title: M-B102126-01 Settlement extract posting schedule issues have been resolved and will now adhere to the required delivery timeline.

documents.text:
Market Notice Details

To:

Notice_Settlements@lists.ercot.com,Notice_Extracts_Retail@lists.ercot.com,Notice_Extracts_Wholesale@lists.ercot.com,Notice_Operations@lists.ercot.com

Sent:

10/21/26, 11:00 AM

Subject:

M-B102126-01 Settlement extract posting schedule issues have been resolved and will now adhere to the required delivery timeline.

NOTICE DATE:
 October 21, 2026

NOTICE TYPE:
 M-B102126-01 Settlement Extracts

SHORT DESCRIPTION:

Settlement extract posting schedule issues have been resolved and will now adhere to the required delivery timeline.

INTENDED AUDIENCE:
 Settlement Extract Recipients

DAYS AFFECTED:
 Monday, October 19, 2026

LONG DESCRIPTION: 
While investigating the issues covered in 
M-B082026-01
, ERCOT identified a long standing operational issue that occasionally affected extract generation, causing some postings to fall behind their expected delivery schedule. The extracts listed below were delayed by at least two extract runs.
ERCOT has corrected the issue and implemented additional monitoring to help identify and prevent similar delays going forward. To bring the affected extracts back to their required delivery schedule, ERCOT performed additional reruns. All impacted extracts have returned to their expected delivery timeframe

ESI ID Service History & Usage Extract | ZP12-245 | Rpt ID 210

Supplemental AMS Interval Data Extract | COMS-456 | Rpt ID 1040

Supplemental IDR Required Interval Data Extract | COMS-457 | Rpt ID 1041

Recorder Extract | ZP11-489 | Rpt ID 232

Resource ID Extract | ZP11-532 | Rpt ID 231 

ACTION REQUIRED:

Market Participants will see the additional extracts posted in their associated folders on the Market Information System (MIS). The filenames will end with Rerun1, Rerun2, or Rerun3, depending on the number of reruns required. Market Participants should download and process the rerun files in sequential order, beginning with Rerun1, followed by Rerun2, and then Rerun3, if applicable.

CONTACT:
 If you have any questions, please contact your ERCOT Account Manager. You may also call the general ERCOT Client Services phone number at (512) 248-3900 or contact ERCOT Client Services via email at 
ClientServices@ercot.com
.

If you are receiving email from a public ERCOT distribution list that you no longer wish to receive, please follow this link in order to unsubscribe from this list: 
http://lists.ercot.com
.
